summary: Tested photos on checklist items (Rigging Checks, Electrical Service, Engine Service) with backend pytest (11/11 passed) and Playwright at 1920x800 and 390x844, as owner and as crew. Everything requested works: the camera shows only on the three lists, upload, thumbnail with red X, 176px hover preview, Open full view, tap to open full view, delete, the photo staying after a reload, crew view-only, and the flagged + ticked hover fix. One minor layout point: the thumbnail and X are about 26px wider than the camera icon. Items whose text is near the wrap point gain an extra line when a photo is added. For example, the 'Shrouds and stays' row grows from 57 to 72px on desktop and from 72 to 94px at 390px. Single-line rows stay at the standard 57px (desktop) / 72px (mobile).

minor.issue: Soft delete only; the object stays in storage. Deleting a checklist item, Reset All or deleting the list does not delete its photo, so stored objects pile up with nothing pointing to them.
The type is checked against the client's content_type only (no magic-byte check). list_id is stored but never checked again on GET.

integration_issues.issue: onRemove clears photo_id at once and calls DELETE with .catch(() => {}). When offline or on error, the stored photo is never removed and no retry is queued. The red X also deletes with no confirm or undo.

issues: The thumbnail and X (32 + 28 + gap = 62px) take more room than the camera (36px). Text near the wrap point gains a line once a photo is added (desktop text width drops about 26px; at 390px it drops from 174 to 148px).
At 390px the camera alone already narrows the text column, so these lists wrap more than other lists. Consider an overlay X on the thumbnail corner, or a narrower X (w-5).

action_items: Optional: make the photo cluster no wider than the camera (for example, an X overlaid on the thumbnail corner) so rows never gain a line when a photo is added
Optional: remove stored item photos when the item, the list or Reset All removes them, and queue or retry the DELETE when offline
Optional: check image magic bytes on item-photo upload
critical_code_review_comments: Access checks are correct: upload and delete filter by owner_id = the caller (a crew DELETE does nothing). GET with ?owner= needs the caller in that boat's crew; anyone else gets 404.
The ItemPhoto blob cache never calls revokeObjectURL. That is fine for a session, but blob URLs build up if many photos are viewed.
Doctor regression checked by reading the code only: DoctorAsk.jsx line 59 calls setPhoto(null) after a successful ask. No live AI call was made.
verified: item-photo-add-<id> appears on every row of riggingChecks (15), electricalService (13) and engineService (9); provisions, head and myTodo have 0
Rows without a photo are 57px on the photo lists and on others (desktop)

item-photo-input accept=image/*. Upload sends POST /api/boats/main/item-photo?list_id=riggingChecks (200) and shows the 'Photo added' toast. item-photo-thumb is 32x32 and item-photo-delete (rgb(220,38,38)) sits right of it. photo_id is saved in user_boats.data and the thumbnail is still there after a reload

Hover shows item-photo-preview with a 176x176 image; item-photo-open opens item-photo-full (742px wide on desktop) titled with the item text; Escape closes it; clicking the thumbnail opens the full view (also at 390px)
Red X: the thumbnail goes, the camera comes back, the 'Photo deleted' toast shows, DELETE returns 200, photo_id is removed from the data, and GET then returns 404 (pytest)

Crew (beta added to pro crew) at 390px: sees the thumbnails and full view, fetched with ?owner=test-user-pro (200); no camera, no X, no edit buttons. An unrelated user gets 404 and the crew member without ?owner gets 404

Backend: safety and provisions give 400, list_id over 40 characters gives 422, text/plain gives 400, over 3 MB gives 400 'max 3 MB', unauthenticated gives 401, an unknown boat gives 404, a bad photo_id gives 422, bytes come back identical, and electrical and engine uploads give 200
Iteration 76 fix: a flagged + ticked row has background rgb(254,242,242) both on hover and without hover
